item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Heads or tails? $1 coin with Trump's face and gold finish to go on sale
item.description: The $1 coin designed to celebrate America's 250th birthday and seemingly President Donald Trump, whose face gazes from one side of the gold finish, will go on sale Wednesday, according the U.S. Mint. The coin's design — Trump's visage as “heads” and the Great Seal of the United States as “tails” — was given the [...]

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Ariana Grande bids fans tearful farewell in last concert before stepping back from public life
item.description: Ariana Grande closed her 41-date Eternal Sunshine tour in London with an emotional farewell, announcing a step back from public-facing work and appearances.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Interactive: Diesel hits a 2-year high, and your wallet is already feeling it
item.description: The average gallon of diesel just reached $5.680, the highest price since July 2022 and just 13.9 cents from an all-time record. Here's what that actually costs you.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Scientists are sharing the details of a newly discovered dinosaur, 'Musango'
item.description: Scientists are sharing the details of a newly discovered dinosaur. Paleontologists are calling it 'Musango,' which is named after the houseboat they used on the expedition.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa coaches heading to Shanghai, China to lead international football camp this fall
item.description: C.J. Bennett and Sean Gavin will co-host a four-day football camp in Shanghai, China this October, teaming up with an organization known for international basketball camps.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Digital reconstruction reveals a nearly 4 million-year-old human ancestor
item.description: Scientists can now come face to face with an early human ancestor nicknamed Little Foot who lived 3.67 million years ago, thanks to digital reconstruction technology.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Scientists make surprising discovery after extracting DNA from mummified cheetah
item.description: An analysis of three of the mummies’ DNA has revealed something that could help reintroduce cheetahs to the Arabian Peninsula wilderness, researchers say.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US extends ban on flights to Haiti's capital as gang violence surges
item.description: The FAA has extended its ban on U.S. flights to Port-au-Prince through March 2 as gangs control an estimated 70% of Haiti's capital.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Woman accused of trying to intimidate jurors in Lindsay Clancy trial: 'I wanted to see Lindsay'
item.description: A 56-year-old woman is accused of intimidating jurors in the criminal trial of Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts mother accused of killing her three young children.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Medical groups release 2026-2027 flu, COVID and RSV vaccine recommendations for fall season
item.description: Medical groups release flu, COVID and RSV vaccine guidance for fall 2026 as federal health agencies face credibility concerns.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] South Howard Flood Project inches closer to finish line
item.description: A controversial flood relief project along South Howard is moving closer to a final decision as the City of Tampa released a new simulation showing how the proposed project could help clear the area.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa ranks No. 20 among America's top tech cities, new study finds
item.description: Tampa ranked No. 20 among the top tech cities in the U.S. in a new study, adding to recent recognition of the region's growing startup ecosystem, tech workforce and business climate.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] SAO rules Venice man was justified in deadly shooting
item.description: The State Attorney’s Office said it will not prosecute a man in a deadly Venice shooting on July 1, saying it was justified.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Florida puts license plate cameras on the clock as calls for broader limits grow
item.description: Gov. Ron DeSantis is ordering permitted readers off state highways as Republicans and Democrats call for broader restrictions on technology that police credit with solving crimes and critics warn can track everyday life.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Interactive: How to save on those expensive school photos
item.description: School photos can run $25 to $125 per child — and sports seasons bring a second wave of costs. A savings expert and Cincinnati photographers show exactly where families are overpaying.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Missing tourists in Nepal floods make contact as death toll tops 1,100
item.description: Rescue efforts continue in Nepal after catastrophic floods, with some missing tourists found safe while thousands remain displaced.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Diesel prices climb to highest average since 2022, nearing record high
item.description: The average price of a gallon of diesel hit $5.680 on Wednesday, marking the highest price since July 7, 2022, according to data from GasBuddy.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Hillsborough County leaders consider short-term rental regulations
item.description: Hillsborough County commissioners are set to consider new regulations for short-term rental properties as some neighbors say the growing number of vacation rentals is affecting their communities.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Chevron, Trump administration move forward on ambitious Venezuela oil plans
item.description: Chevron plans a $7 billion expansion in Venezuela, aiming to double oil production as Trump pushes deeper U.S. energy ties with Caracas.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Flock camera helps St. Pete officers find missing 99-year-old man: SPPD
item.description: A missing 99-year-old man St. Petersburg man was found on Tuesday after a Flock camera picked him up, police officials said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] One person found dead in Citrus County house fire: CCFR
item.description: One individual was found dead inside a Citrus County house fire on Tuesday, Fire Rescue officials said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tiger Woods entered plea agreement after being accused of DUI
item.description: Tiger Woods accepted a plea deal on a reckless driving charge after a South Florida rollover crash, resulting in a five-year license suspension.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tiger Woods gets suspended license for 5 years after pleading no contest to reckless driving charge
item.description: Tiger Woods pleaded guilty Wednesday to reckless driving and careless driving in Martin County Court, receiving a five-year license suspension.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Denver police make 7 arrests, impound 5 cars after street takeovers on Sunday
item.description: A Denver street takeover at 10th and Broadway on Sunday night has renewed calls for action from nearby residents.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Why are school photos so expensive? Here's how to cut those costs
item.description: From splitting photo sessions to skipping wallet-size prints, experts share smart ways to cut costs, and get more creative photos in the end.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 8-foot alligator found parked in Manatee County driveway
item.description: A Pennsylvania couple walked outside to find a new guest living rent-free in their Manatee County driveway last week.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Manatee County sex sting: 'Operation Safe Childhood' leads to 27 arrests
item.description: Manatee County Sheriff Rick Wells announced Wednesday that 27 people were arrested following a summer-long, multi-agency crackdown on internet sex crimes in the county.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Manatee County weighs new short-term rental rules, could cost $1.5M in staffing
item.description: Manatee County commissioners are taking another look Wednesday at how to regulate short-term vacation rentals after months of complaints from residents about noise, parking, trash and large groups staying in single-family neighborhoods.
